title: Mandatory Rest Day for Migrant Domestic Worker and Ensuring a 24-Hour period of Uninterrupted Rest
what_it_is: Mandatory Rest Day for Migrant Domestic Worker and Ensuring a 24-Hour period of Uninterrupted Rest

sections.label: MDW rest and support network
sections.summary: This provides MDWs opportunities to rest and recharge and form a support network outside the household, without defining hours of uninterrupted rest.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: This is to provide MDWs with opportunities to rest and recharge from work and to form a network of support outside the household.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: We do not intend to define the number of hours of uninterrupted rest for MDWs in a given rest day.

sections.label: Rest day policy implementation timing
sections.summary: The rest day policy will be implemented towards the end of 2022 to give existing employers and their MDWs time to adjust.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The rest day policy will be implemented towards the end of 2022.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: This is to give existing employers and their MDWs time to adjust to the new policy.

sections.label: MOM communication and checks
sections.summary: MOM will communicate the mandatory rest day requirement to employment agencies and employers, and conducts regular checks on employers and MDWs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: MOM will be communicating to the employment agencies as well as to the employers on the requirement for this mandatory rest day policy.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: And MDWs, as well as their support network, or the neighbours who are concerned or have observed that MDWs are not being given the mandatory rest day, can highlight this to MOM or associations, such as CDE and FAST, so that assistance can be rendered promptly.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: MOM also regularly conducts checks on employers, as well as the migrant domestic workers, to make sure that the migrant domestic workers and the employers are getting along well and the MDWs are getting sufficient rest.
